nodes.name: HTML to PDF — Gotenberg
nodes.notes: Sends the generated HTML to a local Gotenberg instance (Chromium HTML->PDF route) as a multipart/form-data file named index.html, per Gotenberg's API contract. GOTENBERG_URL env var overrides the default Docker service hostname 'http://gotenberg:3000'. 'preferCssPageSize=true' makes Gotenberg honor the existing @page CSS (A4) in the HTML. Retries twice on transient failure before erroring out; 'Verify PDF Generated' catches any case where Gotenberg responds without a real PDF.

nodes.name: Save PDF
nodes.notes: Writes to local n8n file storage by default, reading the binary PDF from the 'data' property produced by 'HTML to PDF'. Swap for Google Drive / S3 / any storage node if the school needs the PDFs hosted elsewhere - only this node needs to change.

parameters.content:
03_DOCUMENT_GENERATOR

Receives validated question-paper JSON from 01_EXAM_CONTROLLER (via Workflow 2's output) and turns each set into a PDF using the question-paper template. Generates 1 PDF for 1 set, 2 PDFs for 2 sets. Does not touch question content.

PDF RENDERING: 'Build HTML From Template' -> 'Prepare HTML File' (wraps the HTML string as a binary index.html file) -> 'HTML to PDF — Gotenberg' (POSTs multipart/form-data to Gotenberg's Chromium HTML route) -> 'Verify PDF Generated' (fails the workflow clearly if Gotenberg didn't return a real PDF) -> 'Save PDF'.

SETUP: set the GOTENBERG_URL environment variable on the n8n container (defaults to http://gotenberg:3000, the typical Docker Compose service hostname). Run a 'gotenberg/gotenberg' container on the same Docker network as n8n. No credential is needed for local Gotenberg.

TEMPLATE: no template image was attached to this task - 'Build HTML From Template' implements the layout described in the text spec (header/institution/exam info/instructions/Part-B table with Q.No, Questions, Marks, RBL, Course Outcomes). Replace that node's HTML/CSS with the real design once the image is available.
